comment: Named-baseline registry for pi-ai evidence bundles (ADR 0065).
A baseline name resolves to exactly one full 40-character revision and one bundle path.
bundle_path is relative to this file's directory; "" means the historical bundle that
already occupies the fixture root, preserved in place and still verifiable.
Select baselines by name. Never introduce a free-form revision parameter: an ad-hoc
